Subject: Next steps & procurement checklist for Redwood trial

Hi Alex — great to connect today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

1) Primary procurement gating: SOC 2 Type II report, signed DPA, and a completed security questionnaire.
2) Commercial path: does Acme prefer a PO (Net30) or will you use corporate card for the initial trial? Any interest in going through AWS Marketplace?
3) Technical/ops: we confirmed the trial would run in us-west-2, logs/audit access available, and data retention controls are supported.

Planned next steps from Redwood: I'll send our standard DPA + redacted SOC 2 report and a security questionnaire template you can share with your InfoSec. We can accept DocuSign for signature or provide a standard vendor form if you need a PO.

Please confirm the procurement contact and preferred billing flow (PO vs card) and whether you want us to route the DPA through DocuSign or attach a downloadable PDF. I'll loop in Stephanie from sales ops for invoicing and Logan for any technical follow-ups.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — good call. A few clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- We require an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II (most recent calendar year). Can you confirm the date on yours?
- We need a countersigned DPA. Our procurement prefers to issue a PO (Net30) rather than use a corporate card for vendor contracts.
- Marketplace: for well-known platform vendors we sometimes do AWS Marketplace, but for first-time vendors we typically onboard via a PO + DPA.

Primary procurement contact is Jordan Ellis (cc'd). Can you send the SOC 2 redaction and the DPA for review? Also, we have a short security questionnaire — we can send it back or you can provide a pre-completed version for common controls.

Alex Pierce
Procurement Manager, Acme Corp

Hi Alex / Jordan — quick technical notes to help InfoSec triage the questionnaire: 

- Data residency: trial workloads will run in us-west-2; we can provide region restriction on request.
- Audit logs: we can provide tenant-level audit logs and export hooks for SIEM ingestion (CloudWatch/S3).
- Access controls: RBAC and SSO via SAML/OIDC supported; we can provide a list of supported IdP metadata.
- Encryption: at-rest AES-256, in-transit TLS 1.2+.

If helpful, I can join a 30-min call to walk through the security questionnaire and mark high-risk items for redlines. Proposed windows: Thu 6/4 9–11am PT or Fri 6/5 8–10am PT.
